copy.Makina ve endüstriyel projelerinizde iht: Whatever the need in your machinery and industrial projects, we bring together the right production solution with our wide network and implement the job from a single source.
copy.Dağınık tedarikçi ve üretim adımları pro: Dispersed suppliers and production steps lead to project delay. We gather all production needs under a single contact person and combine them with our design and project management services.
copy.Uçtan uca mühendislik ve imalat koordina: Machinery projects that require end-to-end engineering and manufacturing coordination.
copy.Birden fazla üretim yöntemi içeren karma: Complex deliveries involving multiple production methods.
copy.Teknik ekibi güçlü ama tedarik yönetimi: Companies with strong technical staff but limited supply management capacity.
copy.Proje gereksinimlerini haritalarız; hang: We map project requirements; We plan which steps will be done and with which method.
copy.Çözüm ortaklarımızla üretimi koordine ed: We coordinate production with our solution partners and report progress.
copy.Gerekirse tasarım, analiz veya proje dan: If necessary, we complete the process with design, analysis or project consultancy.
copy.Tüm kapasiteleri aynı anda kullanmak zor: Do I have to use all capacities at the same time?
copy.Hayır. Yalnızca ihtiyacınız olan üretim: No. We define in scope only the production steps you need.
copy.Hizmetler sayfasıyla farkı nedir?: What is the difference with the services page?
copy.Hizmetler mühendislik danışmanlığı ve pr: Services include engineering consultancy and project management; Our capacity describes the production methods we coordinate. The two work together.
